message: きっとヘタ

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, Sei--」

name: Synn
message: 「Did \{Seiou|\s12\s12}-chan come to borrow books too?」

name: Misa
message: 「...And just who might this 'Seio-san' be? If you can't even remember people's names, you're disqualified as Student Council President.」

name: Synn
message: 「Gah. C-Come on, it's fine, right? You and Shio-chan are sisters--two bodies, one soul!」

name: Paqy
message: 「Kukuku... They do say siblings are the beginning of strangers, ya know?」

name: Shio
message: 「Hark, fiend, speak not such ill-omened words!」

name: Misa
message: 「Heehee, Shio and I started out as strangers and became sisters, you know? That's why this bond won't break so easily.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister...」

name: Synn
message: 「Ahahaha, looks like Misa had the upper hand on you there, Paqy!」

name: Misa
message: 「Now, come along. As your big sister, I'll whip you into shape, Shio.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister...」

name: Shio
message: 「Oh my? Look, a bird in the sky--」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm not letting you get away!」

name: Shio
message: 「Eeeek?! Elder Sister is dead serious! Sir Synn, pray save me!」

name: Synn
message: 「Hmm, I don't know if I should really butt into matters between sisters and family, you know?」

name: Misa
message: 「S-Say that all you want, why are you coming along with us too, Sakura-kun?!」

name: Synn
message: 「We just happen to be heading in the same direction. I've got business at the library too.」

name: Misa
message: 「Hmph, I won't let you get in our way! If you're coming anyway, I'll have you help out!」

name: Synn
message: 「Sure, I don't mind, but what exactly are we--」

name: Misa
message: 「Ngh... heave-ho!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ghhhh!」
Misa rummages through books on every food culture and recipe from all times and places, piling them high onto a reading table.

name: Synn
message: 「Should I put the ones I carried over here?」

name: Shio
message: 「G-Guhhh~...」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't make such pathetic noises」

name: Shio
message: 「S-Sister~...」

name: Synn
message: 「You look like a kid who couldn't finish the school lunch they hated, staying behind in the back of the classroom through lunch break and cleaning time to quietly eat it all alone」

name: Paqy
message: 「Master Synn, your analogies are way too commoner-like」

name: Shio
message: 「You expect me to read this entire mountain of books?」

name: Misa
message: 「Yes. Before practical application, you must first grasp the theory. You can finish reading them in three days」

name: Shio
message: 「Impossible!!」

name: Synn
message: 「Cookbooks are mostly pictures with very little text, so it's not totally impossible to finish them, you know?」

name: Shio
message: 「I am an exorcist shrine maiden of the Asukai family, you know? With my body busy with daily training... I have no time for such things」

name: Misa
message: 「Oh? Even though you avidly read romance novels?」

name: Shio
message: 「*Gasp*!」

name: Shio
message: 「Th-They say he who chases two hares catches neither. How about I prioritize my training and revisit cooking at a later date...」

name: Misa
message: 「So that's your angle!」

name: Misa
message: 「Listen to me, Shio. A sound mind dwells in a sound body, does it not?」

name: Misa
message: 「The foundation of training is health management. And a healthy mind and body are built through daily meals」

name: Misa
message: 「Therefore, you must study cooking!」

name: Shio
message: 「S-So that is your counterattack. As expected of you, Sister, you are a formidable opponent」

name: Misa
message: 「I'm only saying this for your own good. Come now, Sakura-kun, you help persuade her too」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, are you terrible at cooking?」

name: Misa
message: 「H-Hey! Sugarcoat it a little more when you ask!」

name: Shio
message: 「Ngggh... Even I can manage a bit of cooking, you know? Tearing and tossing swarming side dishes, tearing and tossing them left and right」

name: Shio
message: 「It is merely that Mother, Father, Sister, and all our relatives are far more skilled, leaving me no opportunity to serve my own homemade cooking. Please forgive me」

name: Synn
message: 「Ah. ...Uh-huh, yeah」

name: Shio
message: 「Do not nod with a face brimming with benevolence!」

name: Shio
message: 「Something as simple as cooking requires no study, does it not? For I am a master of 'Ki'!」

name: Shio
message: 「I have heard that cooking is love. That is to say, a heart that cares for the one who eats...」

name: Shio
message: 「In other words, so long as one's 'Ki' is abundant, a delicious dish will naturally come to fruition!」

name: Shio
message: 「W-What is the matter?」

name: Synn
message: 「Shio-chan, your logic is on the right track, I guess, but isn't there something wrong with it?」

name: Misa
message: 「It's just the petty sophistry of a child who doesn't want to study.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister! Do you intend to mock the 'Ki' passed down through the Asukai family for generations!?」

name: Misa
message: 「Don't change the subject!!」

name: Shio
message: 「Grrr~, she has seen right through me...!」

name: Misa
message: 「Shio's home cooking is always so bland and clumsy. Even in your oshiruko, you just dump in nothing but sugar, don't you?」

name: Shio
message: 「And pray tell, what is wrong with that?」

name: Synn
message: 「Hey, why did the topic suddenly shift to oshiruko?」

name: Shio
message: 「Around the middle of this month, I happen to have an occasion to make some.」

name: Synn
message: 「Th-Then you definitely don't need this massive pile of how-to books.」

name: Synn
message: 「If we narrow it down to sweets you can make at home, two or three books will cover it. Let's pick them out right away.」

name: Shio
message: 「Ooh, if that is the case, even I should be able to read them!」

name: Misa
message: 「Nngh... And here I went out of my way thinking I'd drill cooking into Shio.」

name: Misa
message: 「Sakura-kun really is a failure as Student Council President.」

name: Shio
message: 「Elder Sister? Regarding this matter, I fail to see any connection whatsoever to the Student Council?」

name: Paqy
message: 「Before all that, I gotta ask--can you even borrow dozens of books like this all at once?」

name: Misa
message: 「Ah... the limit was three books...」

name: Misa
message: 「W-What is it, what's with that look!?」
After that, Misa snapped back defensively while carefully picking out cookbooks, so Shio-chan ended up borrowing only one book after all.
